title: Simplify feed query
bug: Your own posts disappear from your feed.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The query change removes the OR condition that included the user's own posts, so the feed no longer returns posts authored by the requesting user (alice's own post id 145 is missing in head).

review.why: The PR removes the OR condition that includes the current user's own posts in the feed query, so users will no longer see their own posts in their feed, which is a behavior change not announced in the PR description.

findings.label: regression

suspicions.claim: The feed query no longer includes the user's own posts because the OR condition (Post.author == self OR User.id == self.id) was replaced with only User.id == self.id, which filters by follower ID instead of author ID.
suspicions.trigger: 1. Create user A and user B. 2. As user A, create a post. 3. As user A, do NOT follow user A (self-follow not allowed). 4. As user A, GET /api/feed with Authorization: Bearer <A's token>. 2. Read response.data array. 3. Observe that user A's own post is missing from the feed (it was included before the PR).
suspicions.evidence: probe_s1_feed_own_post GET /api/feed base returned alice's own post (author id 1) while head returned carol's post (author id 3), showing the user's own post is missing from the feed after the PR.
